duration.text: The Logic at Wuhan University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2736 USD/per year ￥ 19700 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK HSK 6 Certificate or notarized version Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Undergraduate school transcript Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport; Under the age of 40; Have attained a Bachelor's degree.
